target_customer: Orthopedic implant companies and surgeons who need surgical plans, starting with total shoulder arthroplasty
problem: Preoperative orthopedic planning takes days of manual work; the company delivers plans from CT scans and X-rays in minutes.
business_model: API and software for surgical planning sold to implant companies and providers, pending FDA 510(k) clearance
product_category: Agentic AI surgical planning for orthopedics

founders.name: Adrian Kilian
education: Stanford GSB Ignite program (alumnus; not a degree)
founders.background_notes: YC launch post describes him as a dentist and maxillofacial surgery researcher and former voice actor.

founders.name: Jorge Padilla Perez
founders.background_notes: Launch post says he contributed to the original U-Net paper and collaborated on medical imaging research with ETH Zurich, Stanford, University of Augsburg and TU Munich; these are collaborators, not confirmed employers.

competitors.name: Precision AI planning software
competitors.what: FDA cleared AI shoulder arthroplasty planning with auto segmentation
competitors.traction_then: 510(k) clearance January 2025; compatible with certain Enovis and Lima implants

competitors.name: Smith+Nephew Coriograph shoulder planning
competitors.what: Pre-op planning and modeling services for shoulder arthroplasty

technical_complexity.rationale: Segmentation, implant sizing and agentic planning from CT and X-ray must meet FDA 510(k) standards; the CTO has medical imaging research credentials per the launch post.

defensibility.rationale: A 510(k) clearance plus integration into implant company workflows would be sticky, but cleared competitors already exist and no 510(k) record was found for Mango as of September 2026 per a directory.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Implant makers and a cleared startup already sell shoulder planning; Mango claims an 8 figure LOI from a top orthopedic company (YC page, unnamed).

market_need_then: Surgeons and implant companies depend on slow planning services; the company claims an 8 figure LOI from a top orthopedic company, which is unverified and unnamed.

branding.domain_note: mangomedical.io redirects to mangomedical.com, so the company holds the exact .com (observed 2026).

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Outcome focused: surgeon-ready plans in minutes instead of days

branding.community_and_virality: CEO produced the YC launch video; no wider community signal found.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly fruit name in a clinical field is memorable but shares the name with an unrelated voice AI company, and little brand coverage exists.

outcome_analysis: Mango Medical is an active Winter 2026 company with no exit. It reports a large unnamed LOI and has a named investor in Tekedia Capital, but regulatory clearance is still pending and cleared plus incumbent shoulder planning products already exist, so converting the LOI and getting 510(k) clearance are the key milestones.
notes: The Tekedia round stage is not stated by the source so it is labeled other; amount undisclosed. The Dealroom listing for the same deal gives no amount (cross-check). VCBacked also lists Toloka.vc and YC and a Grant stage entry for 2026-04; not recorded as rounds. Some listings give 500k or 8M totals and Berlin as location; unverified and conflicting. Founder education and employers not found beyond the launch post. Outcome search found no shutdown or acquisition.
